name: 20903-prefillheavy-qwen3moe30b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism -- one GPU, one engine, all 128 experts resident on the single rank.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=256, bounded at 4096 requests / 1800 s safety, first 10% warmup and last 10% cooldown by completion (3278 measured).
workload: GuideLLM synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix_buckets: prompt EXACTLY 229 tokens (min = max = 229) and output EXACTLY 1 (min = max = 1), request_format plain, temperature 0.0, ignore_eos set. Prompts are Faker-generated synthetic English and are not semantic.
purpose: A classification service scoring short fixed-length documents with a 30-billion-parameter model, 256 concurrent streams, single GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8
trust-remote-code: true
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# NOT the default here: the engine turns prefix caching ON for a generation model at this commit.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# The operating point: how many tokens the batch each forward pass sees carries.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-chunked-prefill: true
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
